title: Mary Grafton Moberly
dates: (b. St Petersburg 1849/50)
---

contributor to MP (1874)

She and her mother ran a school in Hove in 1871; she married 1882 George Bennett.

Her father’s name was Charles Moberly and he was probably a brother or nephew of the Rt.

Rev.

George Moberly.
